title: Smoked mackerel toast with warm plums

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or a traditional condiment such as horseradish sauce, crème fraîche and honey, with no jars of ready-made sauce or packet mixes.

supermarket.reason: Smoked mackerel, watercress, crème fraîche, plums and wholemeal bread are all everyday Tesco items at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a small pan and a toaster or grill, and the technique is simple stewing and assembly.

works.reason: Six plums, 250g mackerel, 150g crème fraîche and 8 slices of toast make a sensible breakfast for four, and the plum timing is right for wedges that hold their shape.

honest_times.reason: Stoning six plums, mixing the cream, toasting in batches and assembling fits about 12 minutes, and the 5 cook minutes match the 3 to 4 minute plum warming.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the chives and pepper, appears in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is used apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Early September is peak plum time, and the warm, sharp plums are a substantial component that cuts the oily mackerel rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish, wholemeal toast, watercress and fruit make a filling, real-food breakfast with only a tablespoon of honey.
